title: AgentEval History Line
description: One terminal-state line appended to a subject's history.jsonl after a run completes. Phase-7 Task 7.7 documented the terminal-only semantics: only completed runs land here, so the `verdict` enum is intentionally limited to the three terminal states (PASS / FAIL / WARN). A `PENDING` state would imply mid-run records, which is not the contract — pending state lives in the run manifest, not history.

verdict.description: Terminal verdict of the run. PENDING is intentionally NOT a valid value — history.jsonl is the post-run audit log, not the live run-state tracker. Mid-run state belongs in run/manifest.json.
